scope: synthetic contract-only discriminatory audit; no candidate source, adapter, candidate output or receipt read or executed

finding.cause: The expected coverage sets are supplied by the same passive observation being checked. The predicate proves internal agreement, not completeness against an independently frozen set of actual dispatches, counter events, or Dict observations.

valid_negative_survivors.mutation: Remove every FunctionInvoked event, every callback dispatch, the now-unused callback Func identities, and update dispatch_coverage to the reduced self-declared ledger.
valid_negative_survivors.reason: The base fixture contains two actual callback invocations whose omission destroys invocation completeness.

valid_negative_survivors.mutation: Remove all typed_dict_values and set dict_coverage.expected_value_ids to the same empty list.
valid_negative_survivors.reason: The base fixture contains two Dict carriers whose injective observation is mandatory.

valid_negative_survivors.mutation: Remove the CandidateBuilt counter event and all matching counter origins, occurrences and lineage entries.
valid_negative_survivors.reason: The base fixture contains one current counter event whose lexical occurrence/origin must be observed.

finding.oracle_gap: The published 10/10 mutation score mutates one side of each projection while retaining the other side. It does not include coherent omission mutants, so it does not establish mutation_score=1.0 for valid negatives.
finding.impact: Passive binding-point strings and self-declared expected IDs cannot by themselves prove the completeness required by the R4 pause and L0. The executable contract has valid negative survivors and cannot be sealed.

reproduction.basis: Three independent in-memory mutations of p1340-oracle-focal-r6.py::base(), classified directly by p1340-contract-observability-r6.py; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1; no repository writes.

refutation: An immutable successor must bind each required coverage universe to an independent frozen source (fixture, audited callsite inventory, or verifier-controlled cross-check) and kill coherent omissions. Free-text binding_point assertions alone are not sufficient.
